study: Cordray et al. 2012 — Measures of Academic Progress (MAP) reading benchmark+PD cluster RCT (NCEE 2013-4000)
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix: in-person 'four one-day sessions' of MAP training and on-site consultative visits, PLUS remote components — on-demand consultation via conference calls and online instructional resources/reports ('training and online'). (Ch.1 description, p. ~3; activity table)
test_alignment_evidence: Extracted outcomes include the independent Illinois state assessment (ISAT reading, standardized_independent) and the intervention's own NWEA MAP reading+language composite (researcher_made/developer instrument, proximal to the program). (Table 4.1, p. 61)
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting NWEA's MAP computer-adaptive benchmark-testing software/system that teachers then use to differentiate instruction; teachers keep their existing reading curriculum but the adopted MAP package = software/instructional-materials package per the codebook 'software' clause. (Ch.1, MAP program description)
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted impacts measured at end of Year 2 (spring 2010), the end of the two-year intervention. (Table 4.1, p. 61; timepoint 'post / end of Year 2')
